name: Dread, Sublime
body:
School necromancy [emotion]; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, mesmerist 5, shaman 5, spiritualist 5, warpriest 5
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as dread, save that the target receives no saving throw against the spell, and spell resistance has no effect against it.
